title: Reconcile spec 8.7/8.8 .44.7 conformance text with implemented generalized DAO profile
description: Spec-vs-code contradiction (R-05-046, R-05-057, R-05-051 nuance): spec/05-routing.md §8.7 says 'current implementations MUST NOT infer support for prefix lengths other than /128, Target Descriptors, prefix canonicalization, or external egress (E=1)' and §8.8 says a Target Descriptor or any option beyond Target/Transit + final DAO Origin Sig MUST reject during structural processing. But all three implementations (Rust lichen-node/rpl_stack/routing.rs extract_updates:1480-1513 + mask_prefix_bits:253-263 + PrefixDelegations; C rpl_dao_process.c:144-182; Python dao_manager/_canonical_prefix_key) implement generalized prefix lengths + canonicalization + delegation + Target Descriptors (exact len 4 accepted) in the live path, with vector suites pinning that behavior (test/vectors/dao_prefix_authorization.rs matrix, rpl_route_state.json equal_descriptor_change_rejected etc.). E=1 and /0 fail closed everywhere (compliant). Resolution options: (a) update spec to declare the generalized profile current, (b) gate the generalized path behind config with .44.7 defaults. Editorial decision — needs human sign-off; do not change spec or code unilaterally. Related: §8.7.1 reserves /0 authorization via ::/0 delegation but all impls hard-fail ::/0 (fail-closed, deliberate).
